title: CLI CodeMode conformance case file
description: A file in conformance/cases/ is a JSON array of cases. Case ids are unique across all files.

id.description: Unique, kebab-case, prefixed with the spec family (lang1-, op2-, cap3-...).

spec.description: Requirement IDs from docs/SPEC.md this case checks.

known_deviation.description: The Go reference engine fails this case; see DEVIATIONS.md. Go skips it. Ports should still run it.

mode.description: run: Run(program); eval: Eval(program as one expression); check: Compile(program), diagnostics only, nothing runs; register: register `ops` in order and expect register_error; fingerprint: compare capability fingerprints of `ops` and `ops_b`.

file.description: File name passed to the engine. `<stdin>` means a program from stdin: imports are unavailable.

ops.description: Stub operations registered (in this order) before the case runs.

ops_b.description: fingerprint mode only: the second registry.

program.description: Program source, or the expression for mode eval. Empty for register/fingerprint.

input.description: JSON value exposed as the global `input`. Absent means null.

deny_side_effects.description: Policy.Allow rejects any operation whose side_effects is listed.

returns.description: Canned JSON result. Absent or null means the handler resolves to null.

throws.description: The handler fails with this message.

panics.description: The handler crashes (panic / uncaught exception); the host must survive and reject the call.

delay_ms.description: Resolve after this many ms (applies before returns/throws).

blocks_until_cancel.description: Never resolves on its own; ends only when the run is cancelled or times out.

no_handler.description: Register without a handler (must be rejected).

expect.description: Exactly one of result, error, diagnostics, register_error (or, for fingerprint mode, fingerprint) decides the outcome; the other fields are extra assertions.

result.description: Canonical JSON value of a successful run. Objects compare as data (key order is checked by programs that expose it). undefined is null.

messageContains.description: Substring of the failure message. Empty string = any failure.

line.description: 1-based line the failure is reported at (last diagnostic of the result).

diagnostics.description: Exactly these diagnostics, in order, and (outside check mode) nothing ran. [] with mode check means clean.

op.description: Name of the op whose registration must be the first to fail.

fingerprint.description: Both registries must also produce `sha256:` + 32 hex chars.

operations.description: check mode: statically referenced operations, sorted and unique (Program.Operations).

calls.description: Exact number of times each stub handler ran (0 proves it never ran).

max_in_flight_at_most.description: Peak number of simultaneously running stub handlers must not exceed this.

exit.description: CLI-3 exit class the outcome maps to: 0 success; 1 the program ran and failed; 2 diagnostics, nothing ran.
